server/workspace.ts.name: Memory files and prompt
server/workspace.ts.description: Reads, edits and caps MEMORY.md, archives overflow entries and builds the memory rules and notes prompt parts.

server/memory-store.ts.name: Memory file store
server/memory-store.ts.description: Allowlists memory paths, blocks symlink escapes, hashes text and computes the gauge for load limits.

server/memory-entries.ts.name: Memory entry parsing
server/memory-entries.ts.description: Parses dated memory bullets, hides expired ones and computes fact identity for duplicate checks.

server/memory-capture.ts.name: Capture step prompt
server/memory-capture.ts.description: Builds the fact-capture prompt, parses candidates and verifies each evidence quote against the chat.

server/memory-dream.ts.name: Dream step
server/memory-dream.ts.description: Reads recent chats together and asks a model for cross-conversation patterns, outdated lines and ideas.

server/memory-upkeep.ts.name: Memory upkeep scheduler
server/memory-upkeep.ts.description: Queues capture, organize, tidy and dream model calls, filing results with journal rows and state.

server/memory-tidy.ts.name: Nightly tidy plan
server/memory-tidy.ts.description: Plans expiry, exact-duplicate removal and model-judged contradiction striking for memory notes.

server/memory-organize.ts.name: Topic filing step
server/memory-organize.ts.description: Selects MEMORY.md lines to move into topic files and applies the model's moves, sparing core facts.

server/memory-topics.ts.name: Topic file headers
server/memory-topics.ts.description: Parses topic frontmatter, renders the capped topic index and merges new lines into topic files.

server/memory-forget.ts.name: Forget handling
server/memory-forget.ts.description: Removes notes mentioning given words from memory files and routes bot memory updates and forget requests.

server/memory-fact-checks.ts.name: Dream fact checks
server/memory-fact-checks.ts.description: Rejects dream facts whose quotes are missing from the cited chats or whose numbers are unquoted.

server/memory-journal.ts.name: Memory change journal
server/memory-journal.ts.description: Records every memory file change outside the workspace with diffs, turn-boundary attribution and undo.

server/thread-notes.ts.name: Conversation notes
server/thread-notes.ts.description: Keeps per-conversation notes loaded only in that chat and lists reachable threads for session search.

server/recall.ts.name: Auto-recall builder
server/recall.ts.description: Searches topics, memory files and conversations for a message and renders a fenced, capped recall block.

server/recent-work.ts.name: Recent-work brief
server/recent-work.ts.description: Builds the two-day brief of what the bot said elsewhere and parses since/until time filters.

server/digest.ts.name: Turn digest
server/digest.ts.description: Builds the compact per-turn digest of tools, files, memory changes and reply head stored as a message.

server/bot-folder.ts.name: Bot folder and soul
server/bot-folder.ts.description: Renders SOUL.md as the fenced standing-instructions block ranked above memory and skills.

server/host/conversation-compaction.ts.name: Conversation compaction
server/host/conversation-compaction.ts.description: Decides when to fold history, drafts the summary and appends a compaction record leaving originals intact.

server/host/resume-check.ts.name: Resume check
server/host/resume-check.ts.description: Computes replay inputs and whether the next turn resumes the engine session after compaction.

server/resume-plan.ts.name: Resume plan
server/resume-plan.ts.description: Decides whether a turn resumes its engine session or rebuilds from the transcript.

server/tool-results.ts.name: Large tool result store
server/tool-results.ts.description: Saves redacted overflow tool output for an hour so the model can read it by id and offset.

server/tool-list-budget.ts.name: Tool list budget
server/tool-list-budget.ts.description: Shrinks tool schemas and descriptions to fit a byte budget for engines that silently drop tools.

server/drivers/agents-result.ts.name: Bounded tool results
server/drivers/agents-result.ts.description: Cuts tool results over 24,000 chars to a preview and points the model to tool_result_read.

server/drivers/agents-catalog.ts.name: Agents tool catalog
server/drivers/agents-catalog.ts.description: Defines memory_update, memory_log, session_search, skills_list and skill_manage tool schemas.

server/drivers/agents-call.ts.name: Agents tool dispatch
server/drivers/agents-call.ts.description: Runs memory_update, memory_log, session_search and session_read calls against the harness API.

server/drivers/memory-search-text.ts.name: Search result text
server/drivers/memory-search-text.ts.description: Formats memory, team and thread hits for session_search results the model reads.

server/drivers/claude-own-memory.ts.name: Claude auto-memory off
server/drivers/claude-own-memory.ts.description: Defines the env flag that disables Claude Code's own memory so only OpenMausBot memory is used.

server/drivers/openai-compat.ts.name: OpenAI-compatible driver
server/drivers/openai-compat.ts.description: Calls OpenAI-style APIs and adds OpenRouter cache_control and session_id for Claude models.

server/cache-keepwarm.ts.name: Cache keep-warm
server/cache-keepwarm.ts.description: Pings subscription Claude sessions near cache expiry to avoid re-writing large prompts.

server/skills.ts.name: Skill store
server/skills.ts.description: Stores skills per bot, stages and undoes skill writes, links them to engines and builds the skills index.

server/skill-learn.ts.name: Skill learning prompt
server/skill-learn.ts.description: Parses /learn commands and builds the skill-authoring prompt and standards.

server/skill-review.ts.name: Automatic skill review
server/skill-review.ts.description: Counts tool steps per chat and runs a tool-less review that stages skill creates or updates.

server/skill-library.ts.name: Skill library
server/skill-library.ts.description: Loads bundled and library skills, selects them by trigger terms and renders skill instructions.

server/skills-for-all-bots.ts.name: Skills for all bots
server/skills-for-all-bots.ts.description: Keeps one person's skill copy and syncs it into each of their bots as a managed skill.

server/host/skills-library.ts.name: Skills host
server/host/skills-library.ts.description: Builds a turn's skills index, imports and slash-command expansion across own, library and project skills.

server/saved-steps/saved-steps.ts.name: Saved steps wiring
server/saved-steps/saved-steps.ts.description: Wires the computer-use recipe journal, store and replay dispatch into the server.

server/saved-steps/rules.ts.name: Saved step rules
server/saved-steps/rules.ts.description: Defines recipe steps and the refusals that stop unsafe computer-use sequences from being saved.

server/saved-steps/dispatch.ts.name: Saved step replay
server/saved-steps/dispatch.ts.description: Replays a stored computer-use recipe for a matching request without calling the model.

server/side-jobs.ts.name: Background text jobs
server/side-jobs.ts.description: Picks the engine or opt-in helper model for compaction, memory and skill-review one-shot calls.

server/team-memory.ts.name: Team memory
server/team-memory.ts.description: Stores reviewed bot-proposed section facts and renders them into prompts within a 6,000-byte cap.

server/profile-learned.ts.name: Learned About me
server/profile-learned.ts.description: Tracks facts bots added to About me, removable and never re-added once removed or forgotten.

shared/memory-model.ts.name: Memory model types
shared/memory-model.ts.description: Types the model selection and outcome used by memory background calls.

shared/context-breakdown.ts.name: Context breakdown type
shared/context-breakdown.ts.description: Types an engine-reported breakdown of what fills a conversation's context window.

shared/skill-md.ts.name: SKILL.md parsing
shared/skill-md.ts.description: Validates skill names and parses SKILL.md frontmatter, tags and size limits.
